name: Pickup — Muros +2 (Poco Común)
generation_strategy: IMAGEN INDIVIDUAL 1024×1024. Un solo pickup centrado en canvas transparente. Tight bbox crop → resize 48×48.

frames.prompt: A single cartoon game collectible pickup item centered on a fully transparent background. The item is a floating WALL CHARGE pickup showing 2 miniature cartoon wall blocks — chunky rectangular brick segments, bright cyan-blue (#2288FF) with bold dark charcoal outlines, cel-shaded (light blue highlight on top face, mid blue body, dark blue shadow). The two wall blocks are stacked or side by side, hovering and glowing. A soft cyan-blue energy shimmer/force-field aura wraps around the blocks like a protective glow. A small sparkle above. Very clearly reads as DEFENSIVE WALL MATERIAL — not ammunition, not coins. Bright blue, chunky, unmistakably 'wall tiles'. Transparent background, nothing else.
